<thought>To construct the complete retrosynthesis route, I need the template that was used to generate the Still‑Gennari precursors. The search results returned a template with reaction_id 1914390, which matches the product SMILES (a silyl‑protected allylic alcohol) and the phosphonate ester precursor. I will retrieve this template to obtain its mapped reaction and confirm the template_id, then build the JSON route using the product molecule as the root, a reaction node with that template_id, and the two precursor molecules as children.</thought>
<action>get_template</action>
<action_input>{
  "template_id": "1914390"
}</action_input>
